title: Gentle Yoga & Meditation
description: A nurturing practice that combines gentle yoga with guided meditation. This class focuses on slow, mindful movement, deep stretching, and restorative poses followed by meditation techniques for stress reduction and relaxation. Perfect for those seeking a peaceful practice or recovering from injury.
requirements: Suitable for all bodies and abilities
Please inform the instructor of any injuries or health concerns
whatToBring: Optional: your own blanket or meditation cushion
cancellationPolicy: Cancel up to 2 hours before class
